newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR firmer across all maturities.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR firmer across all maturities.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) rose slightly across all maturities in anticipation of rising interest rates, traders said.
They said banks were positioning ahead of a possible uptick in the T-bill auction rates later in the afternoon.
The anticipation of a higher interest rate was prompted by the Central Bank's upward adjustment of its special series Treasury bills.
PHIBOR are average swap rates quoted by 20 banks operating in the country.
